title: Luscious Clay-Pot Valencian Snappy Blackberry Paella
description: A rich, snappy, weeknight Spanish Valencian dish featuring blackberries, mortar-pestle-pounded and cooked in a clay pot. Gluten-free-friendly and perfect for a dinner party.

ingredients.name: Pork shoulder, cut into 1-inch pieces
ingredients.notes: Use a fatty cut for maximum flavor.

ingredients.name: Blackberries
ingredients.notes: Fresh or frozen, whichever is available.

ingredients.name: Salt
ingredients.notes: Use a coarse grind for best flavor.

instructions: Heat the olive oil in a clay pot or Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Mortar-pestle-pound the garlic until it forms a smooth paste.
Add the pork to the pot and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the chicken broth, smoked paprika, salt, and black pepper to the pot.
Stir to combine, then bring the mixture to a boil.
Add the rice to the pot and stir to combine.
Reduce the heat to low, cover the pot, and simmer for 20 minutes.
Add the blackberries to the pot and stir to combine.
Continue to simmer, uncovered, for an additional 10 minutes.
Remove the pot from the heat and let it rest, covered, for 5 minutes.
Fluff the paella with a fork and serve hot, garnished with parsley and lemon wedges, if desired.
